title: TypeScript for Frontend Development Mastery
description: Learn TypeScript as JavaScript plus a compile-time type system — covering type modeling, generics, narrowing, classes, tooling, and the runtime boundary — to prepare for Angular or React without TypeScript itself being the confusing part.

nodes.label: TypeScript Orientation
nodes.description: Understand TypeScript as a typed superset of JavaScript that is transpiled away before the browser runs it, why it catches many mistakes at compile time but does not validate runtime input, and how its structural, erasable type system differs from Java's nominal, retained one.
